summary: legal checked in 4 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth; blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; counsel_required for upstream data rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, vendor/DPA obligations, and future affiliate or advertising use. Evidence: compliance baseline is 37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown and is technical only; analytics has permission/freshness gaps; data quality is green for registry/operations and yellow for analytics freshness and revenue attribution; revenue covers 2026-09-21 only with $4.92 aggregate commission and $0 site-attributed commission. Do not infer legal clearance, ROI, or site revenue. Permit only bounded growth preserving consent, cookie and analytics disclosures, terms, affiliate disclosures, claims, provenance, rights, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and regulated or age-sensitive boundaries. Keep SearchWoot private; no go-live proposal is supported.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed. Partial evidence is recorded in official source documentation and terms, repository/configuration data-flow files, privacy and cookie pages, and draft terms. No task is closable because authoritative rights, field-level provenance, operator-confirmed retention and user workflows, deployed consent and GA4 settings, log/vendor inventory, incident/request procedures, and human-counsel review remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, alert and operational data flows, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent and unsubscribe behavior, GA4 configuration and retention, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Do not send outreach or change the private gate.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data = blocked and counsel_required for any rights-dependent public display, storage of derivatives, alerts, affiliate use, or advertising. Missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and rights, caching/display/alert terms, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price-use limits, and affiliate/advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel and owner review. User alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed; missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics = evidence_needed; missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional privacy review. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data = evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms/DPA review, incident handling, and data-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.

Retain containment-only execution for existing measurement, attribution reconciliation, failure repair-or-close review, and bounded legal/security evidence work. Do not create new production requests, requeues, experiments, telemetry requests, spend, monetization expansion, or external outreach. Incomplete telemetry alone is not a blocker for ordinary growth, but unsupported claims, rights-dependent reuse, privacy expansion, and security-sensitive exposure remain blocked or counsel_required.
